reason: The README describes a DSH plugin for adding, removing, enabling, disabling, reconnecting, and inspecting MCP servers through agent tools and a Web UI, making external MCP integration management its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过智能体工具和 Web 界面在运行时管理 MCP 服务器连接、配置、状态及其桥接工具。
summaries.en: Manage MCP server connections, configurations, status, and bridged tools at runtime through agent tools and a Web UI.

capabilities: Manages MCP server registrations and lifecycle at runtime
Connects to configured remote streamable-HTTP endpoints
Reads and persists server environment variables, headers, and host environment substitutions
Exposes managed MCP tools to the agent and Web UI
